acceptance_predicates.description: Explicit online requests use a versioned provider contract and typed outcomes through human and JSON boundaries.
Credentials are injected only at runtime, never persisted or emitted, and missing development credentials remain a warning until live execution is requested.
Live provider or transport failure never silently switches to mock or replay.
Missing, malformed, timeout, transport, non-2xx, and success cases have deterministic diagnostics.
Receipts contain no API keys, raw responses, prompts, or private host paths.

definition_of_done: Focused contract and negative tests pass at exact ASB main.
Human-default and explicit --json output contracts pass.
Independent review and hosted checks pass.

inputs.description: Connected provider/model profile and bounded runtime credential reference.
Deterministic local success and typed failure fixtures.
